Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of G5087 (meaning a penalty); not guilty:--innocent.
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for innocent, not guilty, and it sounds twice in the trial of Jesus. Judas said he had betrayed innocent blood, and Pilate washed his hands and said he was innocent of the blood of this just person.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two confessions stand against each other: Judas knew what he had done and despaired, Pilate knew what he was doing and washed his hands anyway.
